title: Chapter 40 County Country
content:
Chapter 40 County Country

After destroying the three tribes, it symbolized that Zhong Yu had pacified the entire southeastern part of the Lost Plain and became a prince with a population of hundreds of miles and a population of tens of thousands.

He has taken the final step to his goal of ruling a territory with a population of tens of thousands. As long as he returns to the internal affairs hall of the territory, the system can be upgraded, and he can also establish his own country, improve his own system, and start his own cultivation. road.

Gather the three tribes that have lost a lot of population through their own killing. After some adjustment of the population of the other captives, the ratio of males and females was reconciled, and a pavilion-level gathering point was re-established around it.

After the last three battles, Zhong Yu perfectly controlled the entire surrounding fan-shaped area. Successfully achieve your strategic goals, linking the entire territory together.

The place in the rear where you can cultivate is greatly enhanced, and the strategic depth has reached a hundred miles long. more.

It's not like before, the whole territory is like a winding river. If someone is attacked from the middle, it is like being hit by a seven-inch snake, which is very deadly. If you are a little careless, you will die without a place to be buried, and you will be able to eat and swallow in one bite.

The fifty barbarian servants left behind were mixed with those strong soldiers to defend on the spot, and Zhong Yu returned to his Luoyang City with a 100-strong Guard Army alone.

Nearly 20 days after he came out, he also missed Luoyang City a little, even though he didn't have any relatives or family members in it. But he is his foundation, his only support, and unconsciously, he has built a strong sense of nostalgia there.

In the expectation of those territorial people, Zhong Yu went straight back to the house without any explanation. I just left a guard behind to briefly introduce the expedition to the citizens, as well as the current location of their relatives. What are they doing? The hearts of the people in the land of Ian.

The last time I was helpless, my strength was still insufficient, and I still needed to rely on these territorial people. So I had to put down my body and explain to them the situation of my expedition in a low voice. But now, with his wings growing, he has to build his own country, how can he still have the mood to echo the feelings of these lowly subordinates.

Aside from the noisy and irritable discussions of these subjects, Zhong Yu went straight to his long-lost mansion with his guards.

When he returned to his study, his mood gradually calmed down. He has maintained this habit since he came to this world. He felt that in this study, the book full of books could enrich his knowledge. Cultivation of body and mind is a rare place to improve one's own heritage.

Over time, he had troubles, and he came here habitually, which made him have an indescribable nostalgia for this place, so he regarded it as his own forbidden place, and no one could enter without authorization, even if it was to engage in it. Hygiene is also done by yourself.

At this time, in the study, the sandalwood incense was lit, the fragrance permeated everywhere, and the surrounding mist was lingering, making it a place for self-cultivation and self-cultivation.

Zhong Yu was writing and drawing at this time, but he was arranging this expedition, all the gains and the development of the territory during this period of time. Write all the problems out, and keep thinking and eliminating them, which can make your thoughts clearer, thereby reducing the mistakes that appear.

This is that after he became a lord, he clearly understood his own shortcomings and what kind of ingenuity he was. He could only make up for his lack of strategy with diligence and sufficient caution.

In this expedition, a total of about 7,000 people were plundered, and three township-level administrative districts and eight pavilion-level settlements were established. He successfully covered his sphere of influence over a hundred miles and owned a county territory, which made his sphere of influence different from now on.

This kind of personal promotion is not the kind of petty fights before. No matter how fierce the battles in the past, in ancient dynasties, it belonged to the fight between several villages that were not on the table. No matter how intense the noise is, no matter how many people die. The superiors won't care, at most, they will reprimand the magistrate's inability to perform his duties and slack off his duties.

But now it's different. A county's site, with a radius of hundreds of miles, has tens of thousands of people, and it has one city. It is no exaggeration to say that whoever occupies a county, develops it painstakingly for several years, has accumulated thousands of soldiers and armors, and is guarding several dangerous places.

It is completely possible to close the door, build a country by yourself, and hide in a small place to become king and hegemony. If you come across those with bigger ambitions and strive to forge ahead, you can use your own county’s territory as a foundation to plan for the surrounding areas. Thousands of miles, the foundation of being lonely can be formed.

If the times come and go, and the will of God is favored, it is impossible to take advantage of the situation to compete with the heroes of the world for the position of the true dragon, and ask the ninety-five nobles what it feels like. Even if the luck is not good, you can still defend according to the danger, set up the territory and become the prince of a separate area.

Therefore, the kings of all dynasties and dynasties all regarded the county magistrate as the foundation of the country and the cornerstone of the world, and they attached great importance to it. In addition, the land of a county is regarded as the most basic administrative unit, and every appointed county magistrate must personally read the list, carefully review it, and dare not be careless.

Choosing a county magistrate can make the country stable for a long time and increase the national fortune. It is really a magistrate's power that is too important. If the election is not good, the county magistrate will be corrupt and levied excessively, and there is a great possibility of arousing public anger. If this rebellion cannot be quelled in time, it is likely to spread to the state and county, and it will be out of control from now on.

As the local administrative head at the county level, the functions of magistrates and magistrates involve the military, civil, administrative, financial, judicial and other aspects of a county, and they play an important role in coordinating the relationship between the central and local governments and stabilizing the local ruling order. effect.

Therefore, if a county magistrate is selected, the rule of the state can be greatly strengthened. There will be no situation where the superior does not know what the inferior is, and the inferior does not know the superior's intention. With communication, conflicts can be reduced a lot, people's livelihood will naturally be stable, the people will be happy, and no one wants to run out to rebel, and the emperor can feel at ease. Go on, hello me, hello everyone, why make such a fuss.

Therefore, according to the land of one county, in the Spring and Autumn Period and the Warring States Period in China, it was already the territory of a small country. His reputation is heard in all the vassal kingdoms.

Therefore, despite the replacement of dynasties in later generations, they continue to disappear and rise. However, the county has always been regarded as the fief of the princes, and the owner of the fief is called the king. Sovereigns, emperors, and princes.

The territory of a county has always been the lowest level of country in ancient China. Even after the Great Unification. Kingdom, county, county, these three levels were most commonly used in the Han and Jin dynasties. It lasted until the Sui and Tang Dynasties, but it was only a change of form.

So, in the eyes of anyone in ancient times. If you own a county, you can be called a monarch.
